The source leaves existence of later minimizers and tie-selection/access mechanics unspecified. This is an algorithmic prescription with conditional applicability, not a rate theorem.

The first round has no past losses, so the source permits any feasible action. The source leaves existence of later minimizers and tie-selection/access mechanics unspecified. ## V2 source-only corrections

This create-only successor corrects two errors identified by the distinct reviewer and independently checked against the source pixels. The v1 files remain byte-for-byte intact. The v1 report above is retained unchanged; this section records the successor precisely.

1. The source graph compressedExplanation now says “minimizing cumulative loss from strictly earlier rounds 1 through t-1.” Its former “losses already observed” wording overstated the source's generic feedback convention. PDF20 explicitly says “Receive some feedback on ℓ_t”; the FTL display on PDF23 uses earlier-round functions but does not promise observation of their complete values or a particular feedback/oracle model. G-FEEDBACK and the original graph's other caveats remain unchanged. This correction changes no source premise, objective, topology or well-definedness classification.

2. Coverage entries P23-01 through P23-15 now locate their material in §2.1.1. The pixels show these paragraphs/theorems/displays above the heading “2.1.2 Online Gradient Descent.” The final transitional paragraph immediately before that heading remains physically in §2.1.1. The S-OCO node's additional locator refers to that same paragraph and is corrected to §2.1.1 as well. This associated locator correction prevents the graph and coverage from disagreeing about the same use-site. The FTL paragraph/display at P23-17 through P23-19 remains in §2.1.2. Page numbers and all substantive NODE/EXCLUDED dispositions are unchanged.

There are exactly seventeen JSON leaf replacements: two in source-graph.json (compressedExplanation and the S-OCO additional locator) and fifteen coverage locator sections. The receipt includes the complete before/after JSON diff and parent hashes. No nodes, edges, claims, gaps, alternatives, exclusions or scope were added or removed. The raw PDF and all supplied page assets, earlier standing page renders, and every v1 output were rehashed. PDF20 and PDF23 pixels were viewed again for this recheck; earlier inspection of PDF21 confirms the §2.1.1 heading. No new images were necessary.

Prior metadata exposure remains disclosed exactly as in v1. No implementation Lean, original PR215 contracts, old source judgments, neutral-decoder content or surrounding Batch42 artifacts were read during this correction. The reviewer findings were received as two textual correction requests. This successor is not self-approved: independent topology recheck remains required.
